posts.text: Bottom line: Compared to what we thought yesterday the outlook is a tiny bit weaker (which is what the markets are reacting to). But compared to what we thought a month or two or three ago this is a remarkably resilient and stable labor market even in the face of big shocks.

57K jobs added in June (111K average for last three months), less than expected but probably more than breakeven.

Unemployment rate fell to 4.2%, has been stable for 2 years now, but participation and employment rates fell.

Wage growth picked up.
